- **self**: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping (19/3)

## Structure and components

- [statement] Builder classes and LINQ queries are not a security sanitization layer. Validate untrusted runtime field names and dictionary keys separately: the driver advisory describes keys being interpreted as path syntax while values are serialized as BSON values. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/crud/query/query-filter.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-csharp-driver/security/advisories/GHSA-2xqr-fxmx-2cmf

## How it works

- [statement] RegisterClassMap can explicitly define member mappings. Register a class map before it is needed; call AutoMap before adjusting individual members when combining automatic and manual mappings. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/serialization/class-mapping.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] In Elsa issue 6001, the reporter traced an Expression not supported: x.Key failure during index creation to a read-only Key property omitted from the class map. The reporter proposed explicitly registering that property; this is a historical application report, not a universal current-driver failure. (low confidence) — https://github.com/elsa-workflows/elsa-core/issues/6001 · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Find supports FirstOrDefault and ToList materialization, including asynchronous forms. Fluent reads can chain Limit, Skip, SortBy, and Project. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/quick-reference.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Kevin Smith’s historical tutorial says LINQ lacks asynchronous methods. The official LINQ guide documents asynchronous iteration through ToAsyncEnumerable. Treat the tutorial’s async limitation as historical advice, not a universal constraint. (medium confidence) — https://kevsoft.net/2020/02/28/finding-documents-in-mongodb-using-csharp.html · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Call AsQueryable() on a typed collection to compose LINQ queries; the driver translates supported LINQ expressions into aggregation operations rather than supporting every possible C# expression. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-analyzer/current/code-type/linq.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Query filters select documents for reads, updates and deletes; Builders<TDocument>.Filter provides builder methods for those filters. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/crud/query/query-filter.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Typed equality filters can be passed to Find; the query-filter guide also shows the equivalent lambda predicate directly in Find. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/crud/query/query-filter.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/quick-reference.md
- [statement] The CRUD API exposes InsertOne and InsertMany for POCO documents, with asynchronous counterparts. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/quick-reference.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] ReplaceOne accepts a replacement POCO and a filter; DeleteOne and DeleteMany accept filters, with asynchronous variants shown in the quick reference. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/quick-reference.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] For LINQ diagnostics, ToString exposes the translated pipeline for non-scalar query objects. LoggedStages exposes it for scalar operations and must be read immediately after execution. LoggedStages is not thread-safe. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] A POCO collection uses an automatic class map that matches document field names to class property names; incompatible property and field types can produce deserialization exceptions. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/serialization/class-mapping.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Typed collections can represent BSON documents as C# objects. The driver uses a class map to serialize and deserialize those objects. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/serialization/class-mapping.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://kevsoft.net/2020/02/28/finding-documents-in-mongodb-using-csharp.html
- [statement] Filter builders and lambda predicates provide alternative ways to express equality queries passed to Find. Builder filters can also be composed conditionally. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/crud/query/query-filter.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://kevsoft.net/2020/02/28/finding-documents-in-mongodb-using-csharp.html
- [statement] An empty filter matches all documents. Query filters select the documents that read, update, and delete operations target. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/crud/query/query-filter.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Call AsQueryable on a collection to compose LINQ queries. The driver translates supported statements into aggregation pipeline stages, including Where into $match and Select into $project. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] Not every LINQ expression maps to a MongoDB query. The official guide lists unsupported Replace overloads that throw ExpressionNotSupportedException at runtime. (medium confidence) — https://kevsoft.net/2020/02/28/finding-documents-in-mongodb-using-csharp.html · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/aggregation/linq.md
- [statement] The version-three upgrade guide states that LINQ2 was removed and LINQ3 must be used for LINQ queries. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/upgrade/v3.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
- [statement] For client-side projections, the version-three upgrade guide documents ExpressionNotSupportedException by default and an opt-in through EnableClientSideProjections on TranslationOptions. These options can apply to an individual query or to MongoClientSettings. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/csharp/current/reference/upgrade/v3.md · keywords: C#/.NET driver CRUD with builders, LINQ provider and POCO mapping
